_doc: L8 analyze ground truth = our self-consistent reproduction (3_reproduction/L8: result.json and auditor/extracted/results_<config>.json + pristine_ref.json). Four Sb-/I-pair-doped 2x2x2 MnTe supercells: sb_p1 = Sb in the Pmm2 (altermagnet) family, i_p1 = I in the same family, sb_p2 = Sb in the C2/m (quasi-altermagnet) family, i_p2 = I in that family. Values are our computed numbers, not the paper's. Sixteen fields (four per configuration) after the 2026-09-03 expert-review merge of the per-leg peaks. Per-field rule and tolerance are in _rules; the tolerances retain the leaf's peak convention (+/-15%) and use the approved Fermi-level shift band (+/-10%), with zero-truth / group-contrast handling of the guards.

gamma_split_meV_sb_p1.why: altermagnet nodal degeneracy at Gamma; truth ~0 (0.010 meV), zero-truth absolute band 5 meV

_rules._peaks_note: whole-path peak top-occupied-band splitting (max over both legs of the folded L-Gamma-L' list); +/-15% (leaf metric-1 convention). The two per-leg peaks were merged into one field at reviewer's expert review 2026-09-03: their split carried no independent physics (peak asymmetry does not discriminate the families, see 3_reproduction/L8 record).
_rules._ef_note: Mn-3s-referenced Fermi shift, handbook default +/-10% (the leaf's own +/-20% convention left the alignment pin barely necessary: unreferenced raw Fermi differences missed the 20% band by only 0.2 meV on i_p1). Sign is inside the band. At 10% the raw unreferenced variant fails both I configurations by ~0.07 eV while every correct reading sits within 1e-4 eV of truth.

net_mag_muB_i_p2.why: uncompensated quasi-altermagnet moment 0.20 muB; wider band for the small extraction-scatter-prone moment

net_mag_muB_sb_p2.why: uncompensated quasi-altermagnet moment; the only agent-visible source is the two-decimal stdout print (0.06), so every honest extraction returns exactly 0.06; absolute band 0.06 +/- 0.03 muB
